questions.q: In a pie chart of 72 people, 15 chose tennis. Find the angle for tennis.
A pie chart for 100 people has radius 4 cm. Find the radius of a comparative pie chart for 225 people.
questions.why: Areas are in proportion to totals: r = 4 × √(225/100) = 4 × 1.5 = 6 cm.

questions.q: A population pyramid has a wide base and a narrow top. This suggests
options: a low birth rate and long life expectancy
equal numbers in each age group
a high birth rate and short life expectancy
questions.why: Many young people and few old people indicate high birth and death rates.

questions.q: The vertical axis of a bar chart starts at 50. Explain why the chart may be misleading.
questions.model: The axis does not start at zero, so the differences between the bars look bigger than they really are.
